items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was around my place this afternoon with Punch Miller. [INTERVIEWEE] They would tell me that that man date. And I seen the man.

ctx.x: Well, that's what I'm saying. He used to work on the Clark Cracker factory, that's right.
He was around my place this afternoon with Punch Miller.
They would tell me that that man date. And I seen the man. I said, hey, he ain't date. And they said, man, date over seven years.
